update.comment: 2.1.0: zone weather anywhere in CONUS. P1 rasterizes the NWS fire weather zones when there is no weather zone grid; P3 builds the zone daily weather from gridMET with fire-activity weights when there is no zone-daily table; P5 fetches the national FEMS station catalogue when none is set. Data Sources GridMetFolder; every project gets the 3,373 CONUS fire weather zones.

action.item: ALTER TABLE lucasFireC2F_DataSource ADD COLUMN GridMetFolder TEXT
